label: Bible Study
prompt: The _____ of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
verse: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
note: The whole book of Obadiah is one chapter — and it starts with Edom's pride in its cliffside cities.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: As a _____ seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
verse: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
note: God goes looking for scattered sheep on 'the cloudy and dark day' — the exact day you'd get lost.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his _____. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
verse: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
note: God spoke with Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend — while young Joshua never left the tent.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again _____: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
verse: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?
note: Naomi left Bethlehem with a family and came home with none — except a daughter-in-law who wouldn't leave.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not _____ thy son, thine only son from me.
verse: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
note: At Moriah the knife was stopped: Abraham had not 'withheld' his only son — echoed in Romans 8:32's 'spared not his own Son.'
